verdict.rationale: Flagright's homepage names an in-product AI Agents capability for AML operations and AI-native case management workflows for investigations, so the product itself appears to offer agent-assisted investigation. These are one-line marketing claims, and nothing specifically documents agents investigating transaction alerts or drafting review notes. The docs MCP server is a documentation endpoint for AI clients, not an in-product agent, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented agent workflow for transaction alert investigation, documented generation of review notes or case narratives, explainability and output details, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to investigate transaction alerts and prepare review notes
